Getting started guide

Three steps to get going. This page carries a title, a meta description, an h1 and Article schema, so the crawler should find fewer issues here than on the pricing page — which is the point: the detector output should differ per page in ways a reviewer can check by reading the HTML.

  1. Add a property config.
  2. Run the pipeline.
  3. Review the prioritised opportunities.
